Definition: Shammai, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Shammai = "desolate"; 1) a Judaite, son of Onam and descendant of Jerahmeel; 2) a Judaite, son of Rekem, father of Maon, and descendant of Jerahmeel's brother, Caleb; 3) a Judaite, son of Mered and brother of Miriam and Ishbah
